_notes.cycle_start: Launch of the 2026-27 surveys (UTC). Summer 2026 is its own cycle and enters as a carried-forward wave (build_historical.py --summer2026). Everything recorded before cycle_start is excluded as before_cycle.
_notes.eligible_states: all (decided Oct 9, 2026: every school in the NCES dropdown is eligible, territories included) or 50_plus_dc.
_notes.speeder_seconds: Completes faster than this are invalid (reason speeder). Revisit after week 1.
_notes.target_date: Date by which the team wants 100% coverage (UTC date): end of the 2026-27 school year, July 1, 2027. Drives 'needed per week'.
_notes.require_open_school: Decided Oct 9, 2026: false. Closed/inactive schools may still report on past years; cleaning decides later.
_notes.require_in_nces_panel: Decided Oct 9, 2026: false. Dropdown rows missing from the panel stay eligible with level unknown.
_notes.fresh_start_levels: Levels whose coverage restarts at 0 this cycle because the survey is new (decided Oct 9, 2026: elementary). Other levels carry 2025-26 reports forward into the count.
_notes.test_mode: true = pre-launch testing: responses before cycle_start count, tktk rows are kept, and the page shows a test-data banner. Set false at launch (after Qualtrics is wiped).
